DialogLine.Default: We would welcome such an agreement in time, but trust takes time to build. Let us get to know one another first.

DialogLine.Friendly: Greetings. We are the United Federation of Planets. We come in peace, and we hope this is the start of a long friendship.
DialogLine.Neutral: This is the United Federation of Planets. We are explorers and diplomats, and we would like to learn about your people.
DialogLine.Hostile: We are the United Federation of Planets. We regret that our first meeting is so tense, but we are prepared to defend ourselves, and we will.

DialogLine.Friendly: Our Council has noticed your colony in TARSYS. We value our friendship, and we hope we can resolve this without difficulty.
DialogLine.Neutral: SING, your colony in TARSYS lies within Federation space. We would like to discuss this before it becomes a dispute.
DialogLine.Hostile: Your colony in TARSYS is a violation of Federation territory. We ask you to withdraw. We would prefer not to say it twice.

DialogLine.Friendly: Your ships fired on ours. We assume this was a mistake. We would welcome an explanation.
DialogLine.Neutral: You have attacked Federation vessels, SING. We urge you to reconsider. We would still prefer to talk.
DialogLine.Hostile: Your attack on Starfleet vessels will not go unanswered, PLURAL. We will defend our people.

DialogLine.Friendly: Your ships have been in Federation space for some time, friend. We would appreciate it if they withdrew, to avoid any misunderstanding.
DialogLine.Neutral: PLURAL ships in Federation space. We ask you to withdraw them. We would rather resolve this peacefully.
DialogLine.Hostile: Your warships in Federation space are a provocation, PLURAL. Withdraw them now, or Starfleet will respond.

DialogLine.Friendly: We asked you to withdraw from our space, and you stayed. Now you have taken TARSYS. We are disappointed, and concerned.
DialogLine.Neutral: You ignored our request and settled TARSYS. We regret this, SING. It will not help our relations.
DialogLine.Hostile: You trespassed, were warned, and settled TARSYS. The Federation Council will not be patient much longer.

DialogLine.Friendly: You settled TARSYS and we kept the peace, and now your fleet is in our space. Our patience is being tested.
DialogLine.Neutral: First TARSYS, and now warships on our borders. We are beginning to doubt your intentions, SING.
DialogLine.Hostile: You took TARSYS, and now you threaten our borders. The Federation will defend itself, PLURAL.

Dialogs.DialogLine: Declare War The Federation Council has voted. We are at war. We did not want this, but we will see it through. Starfleet is mobilising. We will defend our worlds, and we will not stop until the threat is ended.>

DialogLine.Default: There are others out there? We would very much like to meet them. We have not yet had the chance.

DialogLine.Friendly: Hello, my friend. It is good to hear from you. How may the Federation help?
DialogLine.Neutral: Communication channels opened. Greetings, SING. What can we do for you?
DialogLine.Hostile: Go ahead, SING. We are listening, though our patience is limited.

DialogLine.Default: We would like to learn more about your people. What are your customs, and what do you value?
Thank you. That is fascinating. We will remember it.

DialogLine.DL_Agg: The Federation prefers peace, but Starfleet is ready to defend it. We would not like to see that tested.
DialogLine.DL_Hon: The Federation is built on principles: freedom, equality and respect for all life. We try to live by them, and we expect the same of our friends.
DialogLine.DL_Pac: The Federation is a union of worlds who chose peace over war. We believe there is always another way, and we will look for it.
DialogLine.DL_Ruth: We would rather not be forced to defend ourselves. But those who threaten the Federation will find we do not fall easily.
DialogLine.DL_Cunn: Diplomacy is a skill, and the Federation has practised it for many years. We would prefer to talk until everyone is satisfied.
DialogLine.DL_Xeno: The Federation is wary of those who would exploit its openness. We welcome friends, but we do not welcome trouble.
DialogLine.DL_Exp: The Federation seeks out new worlds and new life. There is much more to discover, and we are glad to share the journey.
DialogLine.DL_Tech: Starfleet's engineers and scientists work tirelessly. We share what we learn with those who share our values.
DialogLine.DL_Mil: Starfleet is an exploratory service first, but its ships are well armed and its crews well trained. We hope never to have to prove it.
DialogLine.DL_Ind: The Federation's worlds are productive, its people well fed, and its resources shared. Good citizens make a strong Federation.
DialogLine.DL_Gen: The Federation believes in balance. Exploration and defence, science and art, diplomacy and strength. Infinite diversity in infinite combinations.

DialogLine.Default: We would like to agree, but our people do not yet trust each other enough for this. Perhaps in time.
This is a remarkably generous offer. We accept, with thanks. We hope it marks the start of a lasting trust.
We do not think this offer is fair, and we do not know each other well enough to overlook it. We must decline.
We value our friendship, so we will be honest: this offer is not fair. Could we discuss it again?
Another power holds worlds in that system, and we have no open borders with them. We cannot agree without risking an incident.
DialogLine.DL_Agg: The Federation chooses its own disputes, SING. We would rather you did not choose them for us.
DialogLine.DL_Xeno: We do not take well to attempts to turn us against our neighbours.
DialogLine.DL_Hon: Setting neighbours against each other is not how friends behave. We expected better.
DialogLine.DL_Pac: You would have us quarrel with our neighbours? We would rather talk to them than fight them.
DialogLine.DL_Ruth: We see what you are attempting. The Federation will not be used as a weapon against its neighbours.
DialogLine.DL_Cunn: We see the trap, SING. We will not step into it.

DialogLine.Default: The Federation's enemies hold worlds in that system, SING. We do not wish your settlers caught up in the war.
DialogLine.DL_Agg: If the Federation needs those worlds, we will secure them ourselves.
DialogLine.DL_Xeno: We do not need your help to fight our war.
DialogLine.DL_Hon: We cannot ask your settlers to take such a risk for us. Thank you, but no.
DialogLine.DL_Pac: We hope to end that war, not spread it. We are grateful for the offer.
DialogLine.DL_Ruth: Those worlds will be ours before long. We will not need your settlers.
DialogLine.DL_Cunn: A world on the front line is a burden, not a gift. Perhaps another time.

DialogLine.Default: We find this offer insulting. We must decline, and we hope you will reconsider.
This seems like a fair agreement. We accept. Thank you.
This is a good arrangement for both our peoples. We accept, gladly.
That is very generous, SING. We accept, with our sincere thanks.
A gift. We are touched. The Federation accepts, with gratitude.
Your request is reasonable. We will help, and we hope you will do the same for us one day.
The Federation does not respond to threats, SING. We will not agree under pressure.
Very well. We would rather settle this without conflict.
This is a poor agreement, forced upon us. We accept it, but we will not forget it.
You made a pact with us, and then broke it. We trusted you. This is a deep betrayal, and the Federation must respond.
It has come to war. We tried to prevent it, but we will defend the Federation.
We are at war, SING. If you have something to say, say it now.
You have brought your fleet to our border. Starfleet will meet you there, and we will defend our worlds.
We asked you to respect our borders. You have not. We are at war, and the responsibility is yours.
You remain in TARSYS despite repeated requests, PLURAL. The Federation has no choice but to defend its territory.
The Federation has no desire to fight you. Would you consider a non-aggression pact?
Thank you. This is a good step toward lasting peace. The Federation will honour it.
We are disappointed you declined. The offer stands, if you change your mind.
The Federation believes that open trade benefits everyone. Would you consider a trade treaty? We think both our peoples would prosper.
Excellent. We look forward to a prosperous exchange between our peoples.
We are sorry that you declined. The offer remains open, whenever you are ready.
You declined a pact before, and now you propose one. What has changed, SING?
You declined our offer of trade earlier. We are happy to reconsider, but we are curious what has changed.
The Federation would greatly value TECH_DEMAND from you, SING. It would help our relations.
Thank you. We are grateful, and we will use it wisely.
We are sorry you refused. We hope we can find another way to work together.
We have studied the PLURAL fleet. It is not what we would have hoped for. We would offer help, but we suspect you would decline.
The PLURAL fleet is impressive. We are glad we are on good terms.
You have strengthened your fleet, SING. We hope it is only for defence.
You cannot hold your worlds, SING, and the Federation will not stand by while others suffer. We will intervene.
The Kulrathi Shogunate lives by a strict code of honour. We admire the discipline, and we hope to work with them.
The Kulrathi follow their own code. We respect their traditions, and we hope they respect ours.
The Kulrathi believe that strength is the only virtue. We disagree, and we hope to show them otherwise without war.
The Pollops are gentle, thoughtful and kind. We value their friendship highly. Their songs are a treasure.
The Pollops live peacefully and keep their own counsel. We respect that, and we hope to know them better.
We are concerned for the Pollops. Their worlds are poorly defended, and the Federation would be glad to help them.
The Vulfen Imperium is proud and fierce, but also loyal to its friends. We respect that, and we hope to deepen our ties.
The Vulfen Imperium is a strong power, and a loud one. We have no quarrel with them, and we hope to keep it that way.
The Vulfen Imperium is aggressive and quick to threaten. We would prefer peace, but we will not be intimidated.
The Cordrazine Collective has a long history, and a gift for community. We value their friendship.
We do not know the Cordrazine very well yet, but we would like to. We are hopeful.
The Cordrazine Collective is closed and secretive, and it makes us uneasy. We hope to build trust, but it will take time.
The Ralyeh Devoted are patient, thoughtful and committed to their beliefs. We respect that, and we admire their devotion.
The Ralyeh keep to their faith and their waters. The Federation respects every belief, and we hope to learn more of theirs.
The Ralyeh Devoted worship death, and their reverence for it troubles us. We hope they will reconsider.
We had a treaty, and you broke it to seize what is not yours. The Federation will respond.
It is over, SING. The Federation has prevailed. We will treat your people fairly, and we hope you will help us build a lasting peace.
The PLURAL have been good neighbours. We would like to propose an open borders agreement, so our peoples can travel freely.
Thank you. This is a great step. Our ships may pass freely, and we hope yours will do the same.
We are sorry you declined. The offer remains open, if you reconsider.
We held a treaty, and you violated it. The Federation will defend itself. We regret that it has come to this.
You have invaded TARSYS, which the Federation holds. Starfleet will defend it.
The Opteris are hardworking and loyal. We find them endlessly interesting, and we are glad to be on good terms.
The Opteris are a remarkable people, part machine and part insect. We would like to learn more about them.
The Opteris act without regard for other lives, and it troubles us. We would prefer to talk, but we will defend ourselves.

DialogLine.Friendly: Friend, the Federation has claimed TARSYS. We would be grateful if you did not settle there.
DialogLine.Neutral: TARSYS is claimed by the Federation. We suggest you look elsewhere, SING.
DialogLine.Hostile: TARSYS lies within Federation space, PLURAL. Settle there, and we will protest in the strongest terms.

DialogLine.Default: The Federation had claimed TARSYS, and you took it. This will not be forgotten.
We have only just met the PLURAL. We are looking forward to learning more.
The Federation has no quarrel with the PLURAL. You have been good friends, and we are grateful.
The Federation has some concerns about the PLURAL. We hope we can talk through them.
You have taken worlds that the Federation was hoping to settle. We would like to discuss it.
You have taken worlds that the Federation was hoping to settle. We would like to discuss it.
Your fleet has grown quite large. We hope it is only for defence.
Your fleet is small, and we worry for your safety. The Federation would be happy to help.
Your fleet is weak. The Federation is concerned about your ability to defend yourselves.
Your fleet has grown quite large. We hope it is only for defence.
You are allied with TAREMP, who are our enemies. We would like to understand why.
You remain allied with TAREMP, who are our enemies. We hope you will reconsider.
We have no great concerns about you. We hope to keep it that way.
We are winning this war, SING, but we would rather end it than win it. We are willing to talk.
The war is not going as we had hoped. We are willing to talk, if you are.
TAREMP threatens the Federation, and we ask you to fight beside us. Together we can stop them.
Thank you. We are grateful. Together we will bring TAREMP to the table, or to a halt.
You will not help us against TAREMP? We are disappointed, but we understand.
The Draylok Council is thoughtful and subtle. We find their company stimulating, and we trust them.
The Draylok change their faces and their plans. We do not yet know them well. We would like to.
The Draylok hide behind borrowed faces, and have been caught taking what is not theirs. Trust is hard to build under such conditions.
We trusted our treaty, and you broke it. The Federation will not forget.
This war has cost too many lives on both sides. The Federation would like to discuss peace.
We are winning this war, but we would rather end it than win it. We offer you peace.
Neither of us can win this war without terrible cost. We would like to end it now.
The war has gone badly for us. The Federation asks for peace, and offers fair terms.
You hold the field, SING. Let us keep what we have, and end this war. We will remember your generosity.
We hold your worlds, SING. Sign this treaty, and we will end the war, and treat your people fairly.
We are sorry that you refused. The offer remains open.
Thank you. This is a wise decision. There will be peace between us.
This is a fair offer. The Federation accepts. There will be peace between us.
We cannot accept these terms. We would be glad to hear a better offer.
You still hold worlds that were taken from us. We cannot accept peace until they are returned.
We accept this peace, though it is not what we hoped. We will do what we can to make it last.
We were at war not long ago. It is difficult to forget. We hope time will help.
The Federation and the PLURAL have come a long way together. We would like to propose a formal alliance.
Thank you. The Federation is proud to call you an ally.
We are sorry that you declined. We hope we can still be friends.
That is a little complicated. If you wish for an alliance, simply propose one.
The Federation agrees. We will stand beside you, and we hope you will do the same for us.
An alliance? We do not feel we know each other well enough yet.
No. The Federation will not accept peace while our people remain at risk.
There has been little bloodshed on either side. We welcome the chance to end this peacefully.
You will not fight beside us? Then our alliance is no longer meaningful. We regret it.
Your colonisation of TARSYS has not gone unnoticed, SING. This is the second time you have crossed us, and we would like to understand why.
You have taken from the Federation too many times. TARSYS was legally claimed by us, and our patience is at an end.
We know that you are spying on us, SING. We would rather be friends. Please stop.
We asked you to stop spying. We take this very seriously.
You have spied on us again. All agreements between us are cancelled.
We have detained your agent, SING. He is being treated fairly, but he will not be returning.
A spy among allies? We have caught your agent. Is this how the PLURAL treat friends?
You spy on us again, ally? Our alliance is at an end.
As friends, would you consider opening your borders to us? We would gladly do the same.
You keep your borders closed even to friends? We are sorry. We hope you will reconsider.
We have only just met. We would not ask you to join us, and we would not join you, so soon.
We are not allied yet. Let us begin there, and see where it leads.
We are allies now, and we are glad. A federation needs deeper trust, and that takes time.
Why should we join you? The Federation is already the stronger union. Would you consider joining us?
Yes. The Federation will stand with you. Together we will build something worthy of both our peoples.
Before we join you, we ask your help. TAREMP threatens us all. Stop them, and we will stand with you.
TAREMP is stopped. We are grateful. The Federation will join you.
You ask us to join your federation? We do not trust each other enough for that.
We will join you, but first, please become allies of our friends, TAREMP. Win their trust, and speak to us again.
You have made allies of our friends. We are pleased. The Federation will join you.
You are not at war with TAREMP. Why would the Federation fight them for you?
The Federation is already at war with TAREMP. Were you not informed?
The Federation stands by its allies. We will join you against TAREMP.
TAREMP is our ally. The Federation cannot break its word, even for a friend. We are sorry.
Why should the Federation fight for you, PLURAL? We do not know each other well enough.
The Federation will not make war on TAREMP. We believe there is still a peaceful way.
TAREMP is formidable. The Federation will not enter such a war lightly. We decline.
We agree. The Federation will join you against TAREMP. We hope it will be brief.
The Federation Council is concerned that you cannot be trusted as an ally, SING. We hope you will change that.
The Federation Council has revoked our open borders. We no longer trust your empire to keep them.
